workarounds.symptom: batch(by_column=...) merges different groups when the key column contains nulls
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fix batch(by_column=) merging groups that are separated by null values. Target files: src/datasets/table.py, tests/test_arrow_dataset.py. `Dataset.batch(by_column=...)` and `IterableDataset.batch(by_column=...)` treated a null key as equal to its neighbours, so different groups were merged into one batch. (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/datasets/pull/8966)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] EPLB crashes with per_pass/per_token recorder modes
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [Fix] eplb: reject incompatible recorder modes. Target files: python/sglang/srt/arg_groups/parallel_hook.py, test/registered/npu/basic_function/parallel_strategy/expert_parallelism/test_npu_expert_distribution_recorder_mode.py, test/registered/unit/server_args/test_server_args.py. Combining `--enable-eplb` with `per_pass` or `per_token` is accepted at startup but crashes the scheduler on the first rebalance. EPLB requires object dumps, while these recorder modes only support file output. (Ref: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/48404)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: anthropic.messages.acreate(stream=True) caches an empty reply from a non-Anthropic model and replays it on every repeat
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(caching): don't cache or replay a reply that has no output. Target files: litellm/caching/caching_handler.py, litellm/llms/anthropic/messages/native/response_cache.py, tests/unit/caching/test_caching_handler.py. With the response cache on, an empty streamed /v1/messages reply from a non-Anthropic model got cached, so every identical request replayed it and never reached the provider again. This skips caching a reply with no output, streamed or not, on Messages and chat, and treats an empty stored entry as a miss. A repl... (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/50057)

workarounds.symptom: MiddlewareError.wrap discards `code`, custom properties, and the prototype, silently breaking both documented `retryOn` forms of modelRetryMiddleware
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(langchain): preserve model errors propagated through middleware. Target files: libs/langchain/src/agents/nodes/AgentNode.ts, libs/langchain/src/agents/middleware/tests/modelRetry.test.ts, .changeset/soft-dogs-retry.md. A `wrapModelCall` middleware that only forwards to `handler(request)` currently turns downstream model errors into `MiddlewareError`. That changes the error identity, prototype, and custom fields before an outer middleware sees it, silently breaking both documented `modelRetryMiddleware.retryOn` ... (Ref: https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchainjs/pull/11330)

workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(core): stop re-adding sealed messages reloaded from memory. Target files: packages/core/src/agent/message-list/conversion/is-persisted-copy.test.ts, packages/core/src/agent/message-list/conversion/utils.ts, packages/core/src/agent/message-list/message-list.ts. When an agent with memory resumed a run, a sealed assistant message (for example one observational memory had observed) could appear twice in the prompt. Memory cleans a message when it saves it: it trims text, strips `<working_memory>` tags and removes `updateWo... (Ref: https://github.com/mastra-ai/mastra/pull/29537)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Images above Pillow's pixel limit get HTTP 500 instead of 400
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [Bugfix][Frontend] Return 400 for images rejected by Pillow's bomb check. Target files: vllm/multimodal/media/image.py, tests/multimodal/media/test_image.py. `ImageMediaIO.load_bytes` lets Pillow's `DecompressionBombError` escape, so an image above Pillow's pixel limit gets an HTTP 500 from the API server. This converts it to a `ValueError` like the other undecodable-image errors, so the client gets a 400. (Ref: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/60308)

workarounds.symptom: [BUG]: phoenix-evals AnthropicAdapter structured output fails on Claude Opus 5.5 (Bedrock): forced tool_choice rejected with 400
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(evaluators): run LLM evaluators on Claude models that reject forced tool use. Target files: src/phoenix/server/api/evaluators.py, src/phoenix/server/api/helpers/playground_clients.py, tests/unit/server/api/helpers/test_evaluators.py. LLM evaluators fail on `claude-opus-5-5`, `claude-sonnet-5-5`, and `claude-fable-5-1`. Every request returns a 400 error. (Ref: https://github.com/Arize-ai/phoenix/pull/17679)

workarounds.symptom: bug(openai): binary standard audio/file blocks become decimal strings in Chat Completions
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(openai): base64-encode binary data blocks in Chat Completions. Target files: libs/providers/langchain-openai/src/converters/completions.ts, libs/providers/langchain-openai/src/converters/tests/completions.test.ts, .changeset/openai-completions-binary-data.md. Standard image, audio and file content blocks accept `data` as a base64 string or a `Uint8Array`. The Chat Completions converter put the data straight into a string, so binary data was sent as comma-separated decimal bytes. For bytes `[82, 73, 70, 70]`: (Ref: https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchainjs/pull/11846)
